description: Render GraphMake Script into an infographic image (PNG or SVG). GraphMake Script is a short line-based format, e.g. `title "..."`, `kpi "Label" "Value" icon=users`, `bar_chart "T" { Jan: 42\n Feb: 68 }`, `timeline { 2024: "Event" "detail" }`, `style bold` and `row { ... }` for side-by-side blocks; the full syntax is in the GraphMake Script reference. Returns the image and a link that opens it in the GraphMake editor for hand-editing and export. Script errors come back with the line number.

format.description: png (default) returns an image; svg returns the SVG markup as text, ready to save to a file.

name: render_infographic

bytes.description: Size of the PNG or SVG in bytes. The image itself is in the content.

editorUrl.description: Opens the result in the free GraphMake editor, where it can be restyled and exported as PNG, SVG or PDF.

title: Render infographic
